Kannan Assistant ProfessorB.A. (English, Bharathiar University), M.A. (English, Annamalai University), Ph.D. (Presidency University) Linkedin Link Dr. Jyothi N Hosurkar is an Assistant Professor in Kannada with over 13 years of teaching experience. She is highly skilled in Kannada Folklore and is passionate about the subject. Along with the years she has spent in the field of education, Dr. Jyothi has also made significant contributions through her creative writing. She has authored more than 10 poems and short stories.
